newsitem.title: USA: Motorola sues Qualcomm, Shieldmate in patent case.
newsitem.headline: Motorola sues Qualcomm, Shieldmate in patent case.

text.p: Motorola Inc. said Tuesday it sued Qualcomm Inc. and Shieldmate Robotics for patent infringement.

The cellular phone maker's suit, filed in federal court for the Northern District of Illinois, alleges that Qualcomm's "Q" phone copies the design of Motorola's handheld Startac digital cellular phone.

In the suit, Motorola is seeking a preliminary injunction stopping all of Qualcomm's and Shieldmate's activities with respect to the "Q" phone. A hearing date has been set for March 20 on this motion.
Qualcomm said last week that it filed a suit against Motorola seeking a judgment that Qualcomm's products do not infringe on any patents held by Motorola.
